title: Thank You Miami Cocina & Beerhouse
venue_description:
Overview

Thank You Miami Cocina & Beerhouse is an irreverent and friendly establishment that opened in 2021 and has quickly become a cornerstone of Miami's open mic and live music scene. Located in Little Havana the venue combines a full-service cocina with a craft beer house creating a unique space for food drinks and performance.

Music and Performance Events

The venue is best known for its Wednesday night open mic hosted by Trikstah featuring spoken word poetry modern R&B singing and heartfelt performances. The event runs from 8pm to midnight with sign-ups starting at 8:30pm. Musicians are allowed two songs per set while comedians get five-minute sets. The open mic has soul that goes to 11pm with a steady stream of diverse performers wrapping heartfelt often soul-baring truth in folk songs hip-hop flows torch croons rat-a-tat poems and vocal register-defying soul. The atmosphere balances loose fun with deep profound meaning.

Beyond open mic the venue hosts Comedy Night and Karaoke events throughout the week creating multiple opportunities for performers and audiences to connect. The community this venue fosters is heartening uplifting and very special.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The spacious interior is festooned with art books and games throughout. The venue features a funky bathroom cool games and a serve-yourself drinks cooler. The Miami-themed menu offers delicious food made with love. The welcoming environment treats guests like family while always having something to do. Free parking and free entry make it accessible to all.

Community Impact

Thank You Miami has created a community where artists can grow and work on their new material. The supportive atmosphere welcomes everyone regardless of station or experience to share their voices art and passion. Host Trikstah sets an amazing tone with bite-sized pep talks on the transformative power of performing arts and the steady stream of performers meets his energy making it natural as hell.
location: 1701 West Flagler St Suite 101 Miami FL 33135

title: Churchill's Pub
venue_description:
Overview

Churchill's Pub is a legendary Miami venue that first opened in September 1979 and has grown to become a staple of the Miami music scene. Often referred to as the CBGB of the South Churchill's holds the world record for most acts within a single venue having hosted over 20000 performances. After a five-year closure during COVID the venue triumphantly reopened in September 2025 reclaiming its rightful place at the center of Miami's underground music culture.

Music Legacy and Programming

Churchill's has been called the cradle of everything indie the home of the weird and the institution for live music in Miami. Although considered an underground venue Churchill's is no stranger to famous musicians. Marilyn Manson Social Distortion The Mavericks Dick Dale Agent Orange Michale Graves and Iggy Pop have all played the pub. The venue has fostered generations of artists before the world knew their names serving as a sanctuary for underground sound.

The venue's kaleidoscopic schedule includes events every night of the week. Monday nights feature Jazz in the Church with the Fernando Ulibarri Quartet leading the main stage with world-class improvisation and soulful rhythm. The Raven Open Mic unfolds simultaneously in the Bohemian beer garden where spoken word poets musicians and visual artists share the spotlight under the stars alongside local vendors. Two vibes one iconic night where guests can drift between the cool pulse of jazz and the creative energy of the open mic.

Venue Characteristics

Churchill's maintains its original English pub vibe with a portrait of its stoic namesake and gritty dive bar atmosphere. The venue features both an indoor stage and outdoor beer garden courtyard creating distinct performance spaces. The nostalgic decor is reminiscent of a classic punk scene. The venue is located in Little Haiti at a corner that has inspired Wynwood's walls.

Churchill's reopening represents a revenant cultural reset a defiant scream into the night and a gritty love letter to every punk poet metalhead goth screamer and dreamer who ever believed music should be raw real and loud as hell. The venue returns with its original spirit intact and with new life pulsing through its veins featuring monthly showcases goth rituals experimental nights and programming that amplifies artists across genres and subcultures.

title: The Fish House
venue_description:
Overview

The Fish House Miami was established in 1996 by husband and wife Jose and Angela Rivero and has grown into one of Miami's premier seafood restaurants with an exceptional live music program. Celebrating 30 years of business the venue combines fresh locally sourced seafood with blues and jazz creating a unique New Orleans meets Miami experience in the Olympia Heights neighborhood.

Music Program

The Fish House hosts an impressive music calendar throughout the week with BackRoom Live voted Best Open Mic Night. Wednesday nights feature Jazz Jam with special guest musicians from 7-10pm with a seven dollar music cover. Thursday nights host the Best Blues Jam also from 7-10pm with seven dollar music cover. The jam is hosted by house band members Rachelle Coba on Guitar/Vocals Darrell Raines on Guitar Conrad Itchener on Bass and Ray Robinson on Drums. Friday nights feature live music from 7:30-10:30pm.

The venue saw the theme of Blues and Jazz in New Orleans and developed a stage for different local bands to play shifting the restaurant's decor to reflect New Orleans and cajun style. The Fish House has gained such popularity that many artists now seek out the restaurant hoping to play. Most performers are young aspiring artists who use the stage as a way to get their voices heard. The atmosphere is dimly lit like a New Orleans joint with rich instrumental blues and jazz music.

Food and Atmosphere

The Fish House menu is loaded with the bounty of the ocean featuring fresh catch-of-the-day options including mahi-mahi salmon grouper and snapper. The restaurant has a raw bar and extensive sushi menu. Signature items include their famous fish dip made with a minimum of mayonnaise surprisingly subtle and livened with lemon earning praise from Miami New Times as unquestionably good enough to make an additional order irresistible.

The ambiance is nautical and relaxed with marine decor including trophy fish and sea-inspired elements. Miami Herald has acclaimed the venue as Worth a Drive not by the sea but Fish House fare is tasty and fresh and Fabulous Fish. The venue offers best happy hour value on raw oysters and peel and eat shrimp plus an early dinner menu. Reviewers often call it a hidden gem praising quality service and immersive atmosphere.

title: Tea & Poets
venue_description:
Overview

Tea & Poets is a spacious tea and coffee shop and community space located in Sunset Place in South Miami. The venue has created a haven of good vibes and high energy where owners Joaquin and Francisco have built a welcoming environment for artists performers and community members. The space features an indoor art walk style market full service tea bar and live performance stage.

Open Mic and Community

Tea & Poets is known for having one of the most supportive open mic audiences in Miami. The weekly Wednesday event runs from 7pm to 11pm and is open to people of all ages and talents. The community this venue fosters with its open mic is heartening uplifting and very special. The event brings together not only wildly talented singers musicians and comedians but also holds space for more vulnerable neophyte performers who are clearly in search of a tribe to call their own as much as they are looking for five minutes of stage time.

The welcoming environment makes it a great place to potentially do a longer set once performers have put the reps in by going to the open mics frequently. Something bigger than an open mic is happening at Tea & Poets with performers finding their tribe and receiving love in return in a way that is better experienced than reduced to words. The inclusive atmosphere welcomes everyone making it an ideal first open mic experience.

Venue Features

The venue offers an extensive selection of reasonably priced organic teas that are top notch and delicious. On Tuesdays any small specialty tea is only three dollars with an assortment of teas starting at 2.75 every other day. The menu includes creative cocktails made only with tea.

Tea & Poets features its own little indoor market selling items such as jewelry clothing handcrafted soaps plants Mexican silver and art creating a fantastic variety where guests challenge themselves to walk out empty handed. The space includes free WiFi charging stations comfortable chairs sofas and tables along with board games making it an inviting venue for hanging out working or meeting friends both old and new.
location: 5701 Sunset Dr Unit 126 South Miami FL 33143

title: Savage Labs Wynwood
venue_description:
Overview

Savage Labs Wynwood is a unique restaurant cocktail bar and lounge located in the heart of Miami's vibrant Wynwood Arts District. The venue was awarded Best Intimate Music Venue in Miami New Times Best of Miami awards in 2023. Savage Labs stands out for intentionally creating a warm welcoming space reminiscent of a cozy living room which contrasts with some of the typical club environments in the area.

Music and Entertainment

Savage Labs positions itself as a community-driven establishment deeply rooted in the Miami hospitality industry with a mission to showcase local talent and host a variety of community events. The venue regularly hosts eclectic live entertainment including live bands open mic nights DJ sets circus and art shows and special performances.

Musicians Night takes place every Tuesday at 7pm and is one of the best open mics in Miami. The event features a curated mix of professional musicians and those new to performing. Sign-ups are available directly on the venue's website up until the day before the show. The event regularly draws large crowds of music lovers creating an intimate yet energetic atmosphere.

The venue has hosted record label showcases and events dedicated to local artists including Savage Labs Presents The Debut Showcase and other talent showcases. The commitment to elevating local artists while maintaining high production quality sets this venue apart in Miami's music scene.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The venue blends a relaxed homey atmosphere with commitment to showcasing local art and talent. The intimate music venue and social lounge creates a cozy living room ambiance that encourages community connection. Savage Labs is open Wednesday through Sunday from 3pm to 3am providing ample opportunity for guests to enjoy the space throughout the week.

title: Magic 13 Brewing Co
venue_description:
Overview

Magic 13 Brewing Co is a craft brewery and distillery located in Miami's Little Haiti neighborhood that was named Best Live Music Venue by Miami Herald. The venue features a spacious 10000-square-foot space with capacity for 350 patrons including both an indoor taproom and expansive outdoor beer garden. Magic 13 is both kid and pet-friendly making it an inclusive destination for families and individuals alike.

Music and Entertainment

Magic 13 hosts a packed weekly calendar of events combining great beer with diverse entertainment. The venue is known for its consistent and varied event lineup with something happening every day. Magic Mondays feature all-night happy hour. Comedy Tuesdays include stand-up shows with local comedians and open mic. Karaoke Wednesdays offer a night to sing your heart out sometimes even with a live band including Magic Jam Night events. Reggae and Ladies Night Thursdays bring Caribbean rhythms and drink specials. Fridays and Saturdays feature live music band tributes and DJ sets. BBQ Sundays are family-friendly with outdoor barbecues live music from 11am and chill vibes.

The venue features both indoor and outdoor stages with great acoustics and professional setup for concerts comedy and tribute nights. Wednesday night live band karaoke and open mic events with Miami Sound Choir create unique opportunities for performers to sing with a live band. Magic 13 actively supports local artists bands and food entrepreneurs making it a hub for Miami's creative scene.

Brewery and Food

Magic 13 crafts the best in-house beer in the heart of Miami featuring exceptional house-made beers. Local favorites include Islander a smooth crisp lager among other varieties. The brewery recently added cocktails made with a new line of house-distilled spirits.

Magic Kitchen provides delicious food with the venue partnering with Meat and Bone to provide a mouthwatering food menu including St Louis-style ribs juicy burgers and savory snacks. Every dish is made fresh creating a complete beer-and-food experience.

Atmosphere

The indoor taproom features black-walled interiors fire-branded wood tables and leather banquettes complemented by an indoor stage and view of brewing vats. The outdoor beer garden is perfect for sunny days private events or hanging out with dogs. The casual pet and family-friendly establishment creates a welcoming lowkey neighborhood spot.

title: Vice City Kava
venue_description:
Overview

Vice City Kava is a unique kava bar and lounge located in Coral Gables inspired by 1980s Miami. The establishment focuses on revolutionizing the alternative living scene by promoting natural relaxation energy and euphoria through the use of kava and tea as natural and healthy alternatives to traditional drugs and alcohol. The venue creates a safe and welcoming space where individuals can come together to discover the natural solutions that living sober provides.

Music and Events

Vice City Kava hosts weekly music events that have made it an unexpected hidden gem in Miami's music scene. The venue has been described as a kava tea room/underground Miami jazz scene/new age speakeasy/artist studio all in one. Monday nights feature Open Mic at 8:30pm to midnight with host Sofi Sicuso known as one of the warmest most engaged encouraging and positive hosts who casually works her way into evocative pitch-perfect reimaginations of classic jams including Erykah Badu.

Wednesday nights host Open Jazz Jam from 9:30pm to 12:30am creating an intimate underground jazz atmosphere. The venue welcomes both professional and amateur musicians creating a supportive community for musical expression. Thursday nights previously featured jazz but the schedule has shifted with jazz now on Wednesdays.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The cozy atmosphere features unique artwork and comfortable seating creating an inviting space that feels like a home away from home. Vice City Kava houses an extensive and expertly crafted selection of kava and tea products with expert staff sharing knowledge and experience to help develop natural wellness routines. Popular drinks include Kava Cocaine Sunrise and Sploosh all made with love and care.

The venue includes an abundance of entertainment options with video games including PS5 and Nintendo Switch board games like chess and mancala hookah and karaoke nights. A sweet little thrift shop in the back always has something to find and a claw machine adds to the fun atmosphere. The bathroom is always clean and the welcoming staff creates an excellent atmosphere for relaxation socialization or productivity. The venue is open daily from 11am to 1am.
